name: F3 Uranium Corp.
content: F3 Uranium Corp. is a Canadian-based uranium project generator and exploration company focused on the Athabasca Basin in Saskatchewan, Canada. The company's flagship project is the PLN Property, which hosts the high-grade JR Zone discovery. F3 Uranium is led by an experienced management team with a proven track record of discovery in the region. The company maintains a portfolio of 18 projects in the Athabasca Basin, positioning it as a significant player in the exploration for high-grade uranium deposits required for the global transition to clean energy.

Officers

Devinder Randhawa(Date: 2022 November)

Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Randhawa is an experienced CEO and founder of several successful exploration companies. He was the founder and CEO of Fission Energy Corp. and Fission Uranium Corp. He has a background in finance and has been involved in the resource sector for over 35 years.

Raymond Ashley(Date: 2022 November)

President

Mr. Ashley has over 35 years of experience in the mineral exploration industry. He was formerly the Vice President, Exploration of Fission Uranium Corp. and Fission Energy Corp. He has been involved in several major uranium discoveries in the Athabasca Basin.

Ryan Woodhouse(Date: 2022 November)

Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Woodhouse has over 15 years of experience in the mining industry, specializing in financial reporting and corporate compliance. He has served as CFO for several public companies in the resource sector.

Samir Patel(Date: 2022 November)

General Counsel and Corporate Secretary

Mr. Patel is a corporate and securities lawyer with over 15 years of experience in the resource sector. He has served as General Counsel and Corporate Secretary for several public companies.

Directors

Nicky Grant(Date: 2023 May)

Independent Director

Ms. Grant has over 25 years of experience in the financial services and resource sectors. She has held senior positions in corporate finance and investor relations.

William Marsh(Date: 2022 November)

Independent Director

Mr. Marsh is a professional geologist with over 40 years of experience in the mining industry, including senior roles at major mining companies.

Richard Kusmirski(Date: 2022 November)

Independent Director

Mr. Kusmirski has over 45 years of experience in the exploration industry and was formerly the President of JNR Resources Inc.
